text: dsh-irmia-devkit 是面向 DSH 的开发工具，在工具接口中提供代码编辑、批量修改、联网读取、代码符号分析和 SQLite 查询。它通过 JavaScript 注册工具定义，并把调用参数交给随包提供的 Python 运行器处理。用户可以用 safe_edit 修改文件并在支持的代码类型上做语法检查，用 multi_edit 一次提交多文件改动；也可以读取网页内容、查询符号及调用关系、查看变更影响范围，并执行只读数据库查询。适合需要在 DSH 中处理代码仓库、查阅网页或检查本地 SQLite 数据的开发场景。运行需要 Node.js 18 及以上和 Python 3.9 及以上。

dsh-irmia-devkit adds editing, web retrieval, code symbol search, and SQLite query tools to DSH. JavaScript routes calls to bundled Python tools. It supports checked edits, batch changes, call-path lookup, impact checks, and database reads. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+.
想让 DSH 修改代码前自动留一份备份，并检查语法。
我需要把一批文本改动一次应用到多个项目文件。
有没有办法从 DSH 里读取网页并把长内容分段查看？
让助手帮我查一个函数在哪里定义，以及哪些代码会调用它。
我想在提交改动前找出受影响的函数和文件。
需要用自然语言查询本地 SQLite 数据，但只读取结果。
I want to look up symbols and call paths in a codebase from DSH.
Can I fetch a web page and read its text in smaller pages?
dsh-irmia-devkit 的功能「编辑并回退文件」：safe_edit 按文本或行号修改文件，修改前保存备份，并对支持的代码文件做语法检查；调用 safe_rollback 可恢复备份。
dsh-irmia-devkit 的功能「批量编辑」：multi_edit 接收多个文件的替换项，逐项预览并完成语法检查后再提交，返回应用文件和备份路径。
dsh-irmia-devkit 的功能「网页读取」：通过 http_get 输入 URL，可选 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本格式，并用偏移量继续读取长内容；http_post 可发送文本或 JSON 请求体。
dsh-irmia-devkit 的功能「代码符号索引与查询」：code_index 建立或增量更新符号索引，code_explore 可搜索定义、调用关系和调用路径，并可检查变更涉及的符号及文件。
dsh-irmia-devkit 的功能「SQLite 查询」：db_query 接收数据库路径、SELECT 或 PRAGMA 语句及参数，返回列名和最多200条结果，并标记是否截断。

Curated **Irmia DevKit** tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). Nine battle-tested tools ported as-is from [Irmia DevKit](https://github.com/irmia2026/irmia_devkit_open) v2.6.4, covering the gaps the Harness runtime does not ship natively.

dsh-irmia-devkit README · Features：| Group | Tools | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Safe editing | `safe_edit` · `safe_rollback` · `multi_edit` | Backup → edit → syntax gate → auto-rollback on failure. `safe_rollback(list=true)` lists backups; `multi_edit` does atomic cross-file batch edits |
| Networking | `http_get` · `http_post` | SSRF-guarded HTTP (private-network blocking + per-hop redirect re-check) |
| Code understanding | `code_index` · `code_explore` · `code_diff_impact` | Symbol indexing (AST + SQLite + FTS5) with BFS call-graph queries; `code_index(status=true)` checks index health |
| Read-only DB | `db_query` | SELECT/PRAGMA whitelist + engine-level `mode=ro` read-only |
dsh-irmia-devkit README · Features：Zero third-party Python dependencies — pure standard library (`chardet` / `tree-sitter` are optional enhancements with graceful fallback).

dsh-irmia-devkit README · Install：Requires Node.js ≥ 18 and `python3` (≥ 3.9) on `PATH`. This package ships as a DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle`), installed into a profile via `dsh plugin`:

```sh
dsh-irmia-devkit README · From npm (recommended)：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-irmia-devkit

dsh-irmia-devkit README · From GitHub (pin a version)：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:irmia2026/dsh-irmia-devkit#v0.1.0
```

Verify the layer landed before launching:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config   # look for a "# == dsh-irmia-devkit" layer
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

dsh-irmia-devkit README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | `python3` | Executable used to run the bundled Python tools |

dsh-irmia-devkit README · How it works：```
Model → Cordis tool (index.js / src/tools.js)
        │  execFile("python3", python/runner.py <tool> '<json-args>')
        ▼
python/runner.py → python/tools/*.py (DevKit modules, unchanged)

- The JS layer only defines tool schemas and bridges to subprocesses.
- The Python core comes from [irmia_devkit_open](https://github.com/irmia2026/irmia_devkit_open) v2.6.4, unmodified.
- Per-tool behavior (arguments, guards, return protocol) is preserved exactly.

dsh-irmia-devkit README · Development：```bash
node test/smoke.mjs   # requires node_modules with @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools
```
